study: Frozen historical SIRST models on SIDD, no adaptation
source: Existing SIDD-main.zip; author repository https://github.com/Dang-zy/SIDD; DOI 10.3390/drones7060393
models: All six historical stage5 final EMA weights; no selection by SIDD scores
population: All 4737 COCO images from supplied train and validation folders, since none is used for fitting, adaptation, statistics or threshold calibration. Collapse decoded-pixel duplicates, exclude entire groups with conflicting boxes. Preserve native author boxes; do not use segmentation areas as bbox areas.
primary_population: Unique, annotation-consistent images with no detected exact, perceptual or geometric overlap with historical SIRST exposure. Unfiltered unique population also reported as sensitivity, if different.
cross_exact: All 3000 SIRST images, decoded grayscale SHA256
cross_perceptual: All pairs against 2502 pixel-distinct SIRST images; 63bit DCT pHash Hamming<=8 AND 80x64 thumbnail MAE<=4
cross_geometric: Up to four equally spaced-by-ID representatives per each of 64 SIRST background proxy groups, plus excluded conflict images. ORB600, ratio<0.70, >=18 inliers, >=0.6 inlier ratio, normalized inlier bbox span>=0.10 both images, RANSAC2.5px, scale0.6-1.7, rotation<=35deg. This sample does not prove absence of scene overlap.
metric: Same frozen bbox COCO evaluator, UAV AP50:95 primary, AP50 and sizes secondary. UAV category0 maps to evaluator1. Original two-class inference retained, Bird predictions do not count as UAV. No threshold or BN adaptation.
uncertainty: Paired 17/29/43 training-seed variation only. Acquisition sequences unavailable; no image-iid confidence claims.
limits: No claim of certified independent collection; no target fine-tuning or model choice; class/background/size shift is a stress test, not a directly comparable published SIDD leaderboard. No access to Anti-UAV410.
